payload.title: Agent guidance and the fuzz crash issue body still name docs/reviews/_registry/findings.jsonl as the place to read finding state from or to file a finding under: an agent that follows them reads the frozen segment, and a responder's filing fails the genesis pin
evidence: .claude/agents/root-cause-auditor.md:34 (names findings.jsonl as the source of prior rulings)
.github/workflows/fuzz-st-parser-nightly.yml:202 (the issue body step 4: file a finding under findings.jsonl)
payload.rule_violated: CLAUDE.md one owner per concept (MF-DESIGN section 6): guidance names the projection (`finding-registry project`) to read and the event writer (`finding-registry add`) to file, not the frozen segment
payload.notes: An agent told to read open rulings from findings.jsonl sees only the findings born before the freeze and misses every later one. A responder who follows step 4 of the fuzz issue and appends a row to findings.jsonl fails the genesis pin. Close condition: Each cited line points at `finding-registry project` for reading and `finding-registry add` for filing. A test (tier 3) that fails when a file under .claude/ or an issue-body step in .github/workflows names findings.jsonl as a read or write target other than as the frozen genesis segment.
